subject: Action required: benefits enrollment closes November 30
summary: Lumen Labs open enrollment closes November 30; without an election you default to base medical with no dental or vision.
reason: A real enrollment deadline with a concrete consequence if ignored.
action: Make benefits elections in the portal by Nov 30

messages.body_text: Open enrollment closes November 30. If you don't make an election, you'll be enrolled in the base medical plan with no dental or vision. Make your choices in the benefits portal.
